title: LMS-NG WebSocket envelope v2
description: No v1 baseline exists for this -- the v1 OpenAPI document only issued a realtime token, it never specified WS message shapes (docs/preflight/CONTRACT_BASELINE_DIFF.md section 6). Drafted directly from revised plan section A.10.

serverInstanceId.description: Identifies which running server process produced this frame. A change mid-session (server restart) is a signal the client must resnapshot (revised plan section A.10).

datasetEpoch.description: Changes after a restore-from-backup runbook. A client seeing a new value must treat all held state as potentially stale and resnapshot.

subscriptionId.description: Present on server->client frames once a subscription is established; echoed by the client on subscribe-scoped messages.

revision.description: Monotonic per-asset revision (decimal string, same overflow reasoning as streamSeq). A client applies a delta only if its revision is greater than the last one it held for that asset -- this is the mechanism that makes backlog replay unable to move a card backwards (test I10, O04).

data.description: Shape depends on type; see ws/messages.schema.json for the per-type validation.
